notes:
PlanProof 2.25.1 — behind-the-scenes update, nothing new to learn

- Nothing changes in how you check a drawing set. The coded note check, equipment tags, scale + title block and spell check work exactly as they did in 2.25.0.
- Updates now finish installing on their own. The "Error opening file for writing" box with a Retry button, which some of you may have seen while PlanProof updated itself, should no longer appear.
- If an update ever fails to install, the message now says what went wrong and what to do.
- The line PlanProof adds to its usage log at start-up now also records whether it could reach its update location. Nothing about your drawings is recorded.

As always: flagged for review, not a certification.
